description: Structured build candidates for the maintain-tick motor (scripts/maintain_tick.py). PREFERRED source over prose improvement-log `[ ]` items (which carry no machine-readable tier fields). The TIER RULES live in config/build-autonomy-tiers.json — this file only carries each candidate's PREDICATE VALUES; the motor LOADS the policy and classifies (epistemic-principle #9). A candidate is tier-0 (auto-ship draft) ONLY if blast_radius=agent-infra AND reversible AND evidence_sessions>=policy_threshold AND checkable AND low_downside AND clear_win_vs_baseline. An item that is local+reversible but NOT a clear-win (missing any of the last three) routes to tier-0E (eval-gated, NOT auto-shipped). Set done:true to retire (don't delete — append-only spirit). In SAFE/dry-run mode the motor only DRAFTS a proposal; it never edits code, commits, or deploys.

schema.id: kebab slug (stable; used in proposal filename + ledger target)
schema.title: one-line human title
schema.evidence_sessions: int — distinct sessions the need recurred (policy threshold, default >=2)
schema.checkable: bool — has/will-have a ground-truth verifier (a test/grader). REQUIRED for tier-0; absence -> 0E
schema.low_downside: bool — failure mode is bounded + cheap (advisory/fail-open, reversible). REQUIRED for tier-0; absence -> 0E
schema.clear_win_vs_baseline: bool — one obvious correct approach, clearly better than status quo (not a policy/design choice). REQUIRED for tier-0; absence -> 0E
schema.source: where the need is documented (memo / log line)
schema.proposal_outline: what to build, terse — seeds the draft proposal
schema.done: optional bool — true retires the candidate

candidates._done_note: Built (scripts/hooks/continuation-directive-guard.py + 60-assertion test) AND wired GLOBAL (~/.claude UserPromptSubmit) 2026-06-19, verified live (reads .user_message, matches userprompt-prior-context.py:328). Retired from the motor queue.
candidates.title: continuation-misread hook — 'Continue from where you left off' must not be read as a no-op
candidates.proposal_outline: UserPromptSubmit hook: detect a continuation directive ('continue from where you left off', 'resume', 'keep going', 'carry on', 'pick up where', 'continue.') and inject additionalContext stating a continuation != no-op — resume the prior task / re-read .claude/checkpoint.md, do NOT reply 'no response needed'. Fail-open, exit 0. checkable (has a 60-assertion test), low_downside (advisory + fail-open), clear_win (4+ session recurrence, advisory-only behavior). NOTE: agent-infra-local registration first (scripts/hooks/); GLOBAL ~/.claude deploy is a SEPARATE shared-tier sign-off (this session's Build 2 already built it local + tested).

candidates.title: HUMAN.md template-aware open-count grep (don't match the template example header)
candidates.proposal_outline: Template-aware grep that anchors on real escalation headers, not the `[open]` example inside a template block, so the open-escalation count is correct. NOTE: lives in hutter/agi3-status path (CROSS-REPO) — blast_radius=shared so the tier gate routes it to the human (policy tier 2), NOT auto-pick. The clear-win predicates are set true (it IS a clean fix) but the SHARED blast radius dominates (highest-tier-wins) so it is never tier-0/0E here. Recorded for visibility + human routing.
